Founded in 2010, Foshan Weinas Energy Saving Curtain Wall Doors And Windows Technology Co., Ltd. is a leading manufacturer of high-quality aluminium doors and windows. Situated in the bustling industrial heartland of Foshan, China, the company has grown into a formidable force in the building materials sector, celebrated for its unwavering commitment to "quality and services." With a sprawling 10,000-square-meter facility, Foshan Weinas is equipped with state-of-the-art machinery and a meticulously organized production line that transforms raw aluminium into a diverse range of sophisticated and functional architectural products.

The production of these world-class products is entrusted to a dedicated team of 100 experienced and highly trained professionals. This production team is the backbone of the company, ensuring that every product is manufactured with precision and care. They adhere to a rigorous quality control protocol, meticulously inspecting each component at every stage of the manufacturing process. From the extrusion of the aluminum profiles to the assembly of the final product, every detail is scrutinized to eliminate imperfections and guarantee structural integrity. This meticulous attention to detail ensures that the final product not only meets but exceeds customer expectations. The company's commitment to quality is further reinforced by its use of premium-grade materials and cutting-edge technology, which together create products that are built to last and perform flawlessly for years.
